cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: You Can’t Leave Mid-Prophecy
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until the impossible prediction has been fulfilled, disproved, or responsibly revised.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Stay until sunset. Gran predicted this stone would hatch, and I promised we'd witness the result.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The sun's down. It's still a stone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then help me record that it didn't hatch. We can put the prophecy to rest.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll sign, but Gran never said which day.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then stay while we ring her and agree a deadline. I can't witness every sunset alone.

mechanism: A supervises the wording and completion of a prophecy test to keep a family witness until the prediction can responsibly be closed or revised.
confusable: Endless delaying differs from D146; A should allow a negative result but insist on a valid conclusion with the other person present.
comparison: Revising a relative's deadline differs from correcting a watch during a timed tower vigil.
seedUse: Keep hatching stone, Gran and missing day; S03 should correct actual reporting rather than add the standard lecture.
